affect / effect on

affect 在这里是动词影响；effect 是名词影响或效果。

A affects B；A has an effect on B；have a positive / negative / significant effect on something。

No activity affects more of the earth's surface than farming.

原文完整句，来自现有资料正文；只合并排版换行，未引用题干或答案。

原文：

Governments, farming and environmental management

日常语境例句

A heavy workload can affect sleep and have a negative effect on concentration.

过重的任务量会影响睡眠，并对注意力产生负面影响。

常见错误是 has an affect on。比较：Noise affects concentration / Noise has an effect on concentration。effect 还有另一个正式动词义，但不是当前结构。sound effects 是音效，不属于本卡统计。
